Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Reinforcement Learning on Web Interfaces Using Workflow-Guided Exploration (1802.08802v1) · paper method: The Alaska flight-form experiment ports a web page into the MiniWoB framework, replaces its server backend with a JavaScript surrogate and fixes the environment date to March 1, 2017.

cohort4.claim.miniwobpp.alaska-surrogate-boundary

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific author-reported method; no experiment, dataset-record audit or formal proof was independently reproduced.
  • This experiment does not demonstrate successful live flight booking or purchase.

Reinforcement Learning on Web Interfaces Using Workflow-Guided Exploration (1802.08802v1) · paper method: The method induces workflows from demonstrations using a compositional language that constrains click/type actions and adds shortcut steps for unnecessary or collapsible demonstration actions.
